biography: Nico Brown's story began not on the asphalt, but amidst the sun-drenched olive groves of his family's farm in the Algarve. Weekends weren't spent with toys, but tinkering with his grandfather's ancient tractor, learning the feel of machinery and the art of coaxing performance from aging equipment. Racing wasn't even on his radar until a local hill climb event, where he impulsively entered his modified farm truck. The sheer thrill of the competition, the roar of the engine, the smell of burning rubber – it was an epiphany. Though he didn't win, the raw talent he displayed caught the eye of a retired racer who mentored him, trading driving lessons for help on the farm. Now, at 17, Nico is a rising force, navigating the cutthroat world of independent racing, proving that passion and grit can overcome limited resources. His defining moment thus far was securing a surprise podium finish at the Vila Real street circuit, a testament to his aggressive driving style and fearless approach. He's currently chasing sponsorship deals to secure a full season in the Iberian Supercars Endurance series, battling established teams with far deeper pockets.
drivingStyle: Nico's driving style can be described as controlled aggression. He attacks corners with a late-braking technique honed on the region's twisty roads. While he can be a bit rough on tires in the early stages of a race, he possesses an uncanny ability to adapt and conserve them when necessary. Under pressure, Nico thrives; the more intense the situation, the more calculated and precise his moves become. He has a natural instinct for finding the smallest gaps and exploiting the slightest weaknesses in his opponents' defenses.

rivalries.reason: A veteran driver known for his meticulous approach, Ricardo represents the antithesis of Nico's raw, instinctive style. Their clashes are a battle of experience versus youthful exuberance.
Isabela, a polished and well-funded driver, views Nico as an upstart interloper. She resents his natural talent and isn't afraid to use aggressive tactics to intimidate him on the track.
Tiago and Nico both came from similar backgrounds. Tiago, however, chose a path of aggressive, win-at-all-costs driving. This has caused on and off track clashes.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue t-shirt under his racing suit.
Sharpens a pencil meticulously before every race, claiming it brings him focus.
Listens to traditional Fado music to calm his nerves before getting into the car.
famousQuote: You can't tame the road, you have to dance with it.
careerHighlight: Securing a podium finish at the Vila Real street circuit, battling against far more experienced drivers and proving his potential on a challenging track.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Estoril round due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential victory and a significant championship points haul.
